model.same_unit: one unit supplies both requirements; its cost is counted once
model.distinct_providers: two distinct units, first witnesses A, second witnesses B; unused capabilities are not summed
model.all_units_a: both units meet A; at least one meets B; achieved A=min, B=max
model.ties: all minimum-cost witnesses on the requirement grid and all exact-objective frontier ties retained
model.budget: minimum_cost_at_most_two <= budget iff a package is attainable in this model
model.scope: roster-listed access only; not faction/campaign legality, an army recommendation, synergy, additive power or a battle outcome
